text.text: Wow! We had a really great week there! The garden is a 10 out of 10! We will definitely come back next year.

originalText.text: Wow! Wir hatten eine richtig tolle Woche dort! Der Garten ist ne 10 von 10! Wir kommen nächstes Jahr auf jeden Fall wieder.

text.text: For our first Cape Town vacation, we chose the CUBE Guest House and what can we say - we are absolutely thrilled. Even before our arrival, Dirk was there to help us with advice and assistance and helped us with organizational matters. From the moment we arrived at the CUBE, we felt welcome and safe. The entire Guest House is in excellent condition and each of the rooms has its own charm. The outdoor area is meticulously maintained and invites you to relax. It is an almost magical place. The breakfast is a solid 10/10 with a huge selection of fresh fruits, avocado, rolls, eggs and everything your heart desires. Should there still be any wishes, you can simply express them and they will be taken care of promptly. The six nights unfortunately passed far too quickly, but I am sure that we will come back again. Thank you for the great time!

originalText.text: Für unseren ersten Kapstadt-Urlaub haben wir uns für das CUBE Guest House entschieden und was sollen wir sagen - wir sind absolut begeistert. Schon vor der Anreise stand uns Dirk mit Rat und Tat zur Seite und hat uns bei oragnisatorischen Dingen geholfen. Von dem Moment als wir im CUBE ankamen, haben wir uns willkommen und sicher gefühlt. Das gesamte Guest House ist in einem hervorragenden Zustand und jedes der Zimmer hat seinen eigenen Charme. Die Außenanlage ist top gepflegt und lädt zum Relaxen ein. Es ist ein fast schon magischer Ort. Das Frühstück ist eine glatte 10/10 mit einer riesigen Auswahl an frischen Früchten, Avocado, Brötchen, Eiern und allem, was das Herz begehrt. Sollten noch Wünsche offen bleiben, so kann man diese einfach äußern und es wird sich prompt drum gekümmert. Die sechs Nächte gingen leider viel zu schnell vorbei, doch ich bin mir sicher, dass wir noch mal wiederkommen werden. Vielen Dank für die tolle Zeit!

text.text:
We stumbled upon it by chance and were simply thrilled. Great location, super rooms, spacious bathroom, great shower, the view... a dream. Breakfast on the terrace for everyone at the big table like in a large family, Taku, the manager, is super friendly, always in a good mood and always helpful. The same goes for Dirk, the owner; he is simply brilliant, super friendly, always has a few tips to refine planned activities/tours/restaurant visits.
Thank you for making us feel at home with you!

originalText.text:
Wir sind durch Zufall drauf gestoßen und waren nur begeistert. Tolle Location, super Zimmer, geräumiges Bad, super Dusche, der Ausblick... ein Traum. Das Frühstück auf der Terasse für alle am großen Tisch wie in der Großfamilie, Taku, der Manager, ist superfreundlich, immer gut drauf und stets hilfsbereit. Genauso Dirk, der Eigentümer; er ist einfach genial, superfreundlich, hat immer noch ein paar Tips zur Verfeinerung der geplanten Aktivitäten/Touren/Restaurantbesuche auf Lager.
Danke, dass wir uns bei Euch wie zuhause fühlen durften!

text.text: Once again we had a wonderful time at the Cube. The Cube immediately becomes a second home where you feel completely at ease, not least because of the obliging friendliness of the hosts. A very special extra, which we have been able to benefit from repeatedly, is that Dirk Engelmann, upon request, suggests and reserves daily activities, meal suggestions and also accommodation for round trips. We have discovered places and restaurants that we would never have found ourselves.

originalText.text: Wiedermal haben wir eine wunderbare Zeit im Cube verbracht. Das Cube wird sofort zu einem zweiten Zuhause, indem man sich rundherum wohl fühlt, was nicht zuletzt an der verbindlichen Freundlichkeit der Gastgeber liegt. Ein ganz besonderes Extra, von dem wir zum wiederholten Mal profitieren konnten, ist das Dirk Engelmann auf Wunsch Tagesaktivitäten, Essensvorschläge und auch für Rundreisen Unterkünfte vorschlägt und reserviert. Wir haben so Orte und Lokale entdeckt, die wir selber nie gefunden hätten.

text.text:
We can absolutely recommend the Cube Guest House, it feels like visiting your long-time friends :-). Dirk was there to help us with advice and assistance. The accommodation is incredibly beautiful, well-maintained and clean. We had the bamboo cottage right by the pool and found it totally special and beautiful. We simply felt comfortable and it was a great vacation! Thank you very much, we will come again!
Jule & Philipp

originalText.text:
Wir können das Cube Guest House absolut empfehlen, es fühlt sich an, als würde man seine langjährigen Freunde besuchen :-). Dirk stand uns mit Rat und Tat zur Seite. Die Unterkunft ist wahnsinnig schön, gepflegt und sauber. Wir hatten das Bambus Häuschen direkt am Pool und fanden es total besonders und schön. Wir haben uns einfach wohl gefühlt und es wahr ein toller Urlaub! Vielen Dank, wir kommen wieder!
Jule & Philipp

text.text: Quiet oasis with great ambiance and well-kept garden. Very nice staff and great breakfast. In the evening, a glass of wine in the living room with a great view. Hout Bay is away from the hustle and bustle, but a great starting point to reach everything.

originalText.text: Ruhige Oase mit tollem Ambiente und gepflegtem Garten. Sehr nettes Personal und tolles Frühstück. Abends ein Glas Wein im Wohnzimmer mit toller Aussicht. Hout Bay ist abseits des Troubels, aber ein toller Ausgangspunkt alles zu erreichen.

text.text:
A great guest house. Patrick and Dirk anticipate your every wish.
They organize all events and also make great suggestions.
The house, the rooms, the garden with pool, of the finest.
Breakfast is an experience every morning.
We have already booked for next year.

originalText.text:
Ein tolles Guest House. Patrick und Dirk lesen einem die Wünsche von den Augen ab.
Sie organisieren alle Events und machen dazu noch tolle Vorschläge.
Das Haus,die Zimmer,die Gartenanlage mit Pool, vom Feinsten.
Das Frühstück ist jeden Morgen ein Erlebnis.
Wir haben fürs nächste Jahr schon wieder gebucht.

text.text:
We were allowed to spend two weeks with Dirk, Patrick and Paul (the sweetest dog).

Rooms: we occupied the two rooms on the upper floor next to each other. That was the optimal choice. Very modern, comfortable beds and plenty of storage space.
Room 1: cool view, balcony, huge
Room 2: modern, nice bathroom

Location: the location is ideal for excursions to Hout Bay (sea lions), Hermanus (whales), Simonstown (penguins), Cape of Good Hope and of course Campsbay, Waterfront, Chapmans Peak and Table Mountain.

Service: we have stayed in many top houses in the world, but the crew here tops everything. The breakfast fulfills every wish. Simply wow!

originalText.text:
Wir durften zwei Wochen bei Dirk, Patrick und Paul (dem liebsten Hund) verbringen.

Zimmer: wir belegten die beiden Zimmer im oberen Stock nebeneinander. Das war die optimale Wahl. Sehr modern, bequeme Betten und viel Stauraum.
Zimmer1: coole Aussicht, Balkon, riesig
Zimmer2: modern, schönes Bad

Lage: die Lage ist optimal für Ausflüge nach Hout Bay (Seelöwen), Hermanus (Wale), Simonstown (Pinguine), Kap der guten Hoffnung und natürlich Campsbay, Waterfront, Chapmans Peak und Tablemountain.

Service: wir haben in vielen Tophäuser der Welt übernachtet, aber die Crew hier topped alles. Das Frühstück erfüllt jeden Wunsch. Einfach nur wow!

text.text: Very good personal atmosphere with an always helpful Dirk, the tips for all activities were very helpful, as was booking restaurants, online check-in and so on. The breakfast was delicious, always fresh, extensive and sufficient. Gladly again, a full recommendation, thanks to Dirk and Patrick, best regards

originalText.text: Sehr gute persönliche Atmosphäre mit einem immer hilfsbereiten Dirk die Tipps  für jegliche Aktivitäten waren sehr hilfreich genauso wie das buchen von Restaurants online check in und und und das Frühstück war lecker immer frisch umfangreich  und ausreichend. Gerne wieder eine volle Empfehlung danke an Dirk und Patrick LG

text.text: Whenever we come back to SA, we will definitely move into the CUBE again. Promised.

originalText.text: Wann immer wir wieder nach ZA kommen, werden wir in jedem Fall erneut ins CUBE ziehen. Versprochen.

text.text: Brilliant guesthouse with a great view of the mountains and the sea in Hout Bay!

originalText.text: Geniales Guesthouse mit einem tollen Blick auf die Berge und das Meer in Hout Bay!

text.text:
We were there to end our honeymoon. It was a place of peace. Special thanks to our host and the owner for the exceptional hospitality during our stay! Taku, his team and his wife! Thank you very, very much!
I'm just posting a photo of the view from our window. You absolutely have to see the rest for yourself – it's simply wonderful!

And then there's the host dog King, who makes your stay even more beautiful 😍

originalText.text:
We went there to finish off our honeymoon. It was a place of peace, special thanks to our host and the owner for the exceptional hospitality we received during our stay!
Taku his team and his wife! Thank you thank you thank you!
I only post one picture, just of the view we had trough our window, the rest you must go and see yourself it’s amazing!

Also there is the extra host dog King who will make your stay even more enjoyable 😍

text.text:
Our stay at the Cube was wonderful, a true paradise in Hout Bay. Upon entering the house, we immediately noticed the cleanliness – immaculate rooms and common areas that reflected a genuine commitment to hygiene.

The attention to detail in the room furnishings was impressive; it felt like a successful blend of comfort and style. The small touches and details gave the room a personal touch and made our stay unforgettable.

The manager and staff were the true treasures of this guesthouse. Their warmth and helpfulness created a welcoming atmosphere. They did everything to make our stay as pleasant as possible and ensured that all our needs were met. Thank you, Dirk!

And the breakfast – a feast for the eyes and palate! The offerings were not only delicious but also showcased the flavors of the region. The morning became a joyful experience with a variety that offered something for every taste.

We are already looking forward to our next visit; it was a great pleasure.

originalText.text:
Our stay at Cube was wonderful, a heaven spot in Haut Bay. From the moment we walked in, the cleanliness of the place was striking – spotless rooms and common areas that reflected a genuine commitment to hygiene.

The attention to detail in our room decor was impressive; it felt like a blend of comfort and style. The little touches and details, added a personal  style that made the stay memorable.

The manager and staff were the true gems of this guest house. Their warmth and eagerness to assist created a welcoming atmosphere. They went out of their way to ensure our stay was comfortable, ensuring all our needs were met. Thank you Dirk!

And let's talk about breakfast – a feast for both the eyes and taste buds. The spread was not only delicious but also showcased the local flavors. The morning became a joyous affair with a variety that catered to different preferences.

Can t wait to come back, it has been a great pleasure.

text.text: The Cube is a beautiful guesthouse with breathtaking views. The friendly Taku is an excellent host and always helpful and friendly. Dirk, you and your team make the stay at the Cube perfect with the absolute luxury it has to offer. Every stay is a dream! I highly recommend the Cube to anyone looking to stay in beautiful Hout Bay.

originalText.text: The Cube is a beautiful guest house with the most amazing views. The friendly Taku is an excellent host, and is always willing to assist with a smile on his face. Dirk, you and your team make the stay perfect with the absolute luxury the Cube has to offer. Every stay is a dream! Would definitely recommend the Cube to anyone looking to stay in beautiful Hout Bay.

text.text: We stayed here for a few nights and came back some years later. The quality was still the same. Great owners and a great team.

originalText.text: We spent a few nights here and re visited a few years later. The quality was still the same. Great owners and team.

blocks.text: Dream vacation at the Cape: Your Hout Bay Guest House in Cape Town

parts.value: Hello, I'm Dirk, your passionate host at the Hout Bay Guest House. My mission is to offer you much more than just a place to stay – I want to create a luxurious, safe, and familiar home for you at the Cape of Good Hope. Together with my dedicated team, I ensure every day that your stay in South Africa is absolutely unforgettable from the very first minute. We love sharing our very personal insider tips with you and making your trip a true experience.

blocks.alt: Dirk – Your host at the Hout Bay Guest House in Cape Town

parts.value: With us, you can expect a unique combination of modern boutique character and a wonderfully familiar atmosphere.

We want you to be able to completely relax, leave everyday life far behind, and feel completely secure. That is why we attach the greatest importance to personal, warm care that is always attentive but never intrusive. Your well-being and a deep sense of security are our top priorities.

blocks.text: Your luxurious break in our elegant Cape villa

parts.value: Our modern villa offers you five completely individually designed rooms and suites, such as the Cosmopolitan Suite or the detached cottage with its own sun deck.

Each of these retreats is truly unique and spoils you with high-quality amenities such as an Apple TV, a well-stocked minibar, and your own espresso machine. In the morning, we serve you a rich, homemade breakfast directly on our sunny pool terrace – naturally also with a variety of vegan options. So that you can explore Cape Town completely carefree, we provide you with a local guest cell phone and are always available with help and advice when planning your South Africa round trip.

blocks.text: The perfect retreat for explorers and connoisseurs

parts.value: Our Hout Bay Guest House is the ideal place for individual tourists who attach great importance to exclusive design, maximum comfort, and excellent food.

Couples on their honeymoon will find a romantic, quiet oasis with us to celebrate their love undisturbed and unwind. Even if you are just setting off on an exciting road trip along the Garden Route, our accommodation offers you the perfect, relaxed starting point for your great South African adventure.

blocks.text: Security and excellent service for your peace of mind

parts.value: We know that safety is a particularly important topic when traveling, which is why our villa is located in an upscale, absolutely safe, and sought-after neighborhood of Cape Town.

You can feel completely secure with us and fully concentrate on the beauty of your vacation. The many excellent and authentic guest reviews on platforms like TripAdvisor confirm our passion for first-class service. Our entire team works with heart and soul every day not only to meet your expectations but to exceed them with genuine South African hospitality.

blocks.text: Spectacular views in a quiet hillside location

parts.value: Nestled in the breathtaking nature of Hout Bay, one of the most beautiful suburbs of Cape Town, you will enjoy incomparable peace far away from the hustle and bustle.

Our exclusive hillside location gives you a spectacular view of the majestic mountains and the vast ocean anew every day. From here, you are well connected to explore the vibrant metropolis and can return to the peaceful idyll of your accommodation in the evening. In selected suites such as the Corner, Cosmopolitan, or Comb View, air conditioning also provides pleasant refreshment after a sunny day.

blocks.text: Start your South African adventure with us

parts.value: Let us work together to ensure that your time at the Cape becomes one of your most beautiful memories.

We are very much looking forward to welcoming you personally by our crystal-clear pool soon. Simply contact us to plan your dream vacation at the Hout Bay Guest House – we are at your side with help and advice and will prepare everything for your arrival.
